description: I'm Rishu, a second-year CS student and full stack web developer. We're tackling "Field Shift": a decision-support tool that uses NASA data (SMAP, GPM, MODIS, POWER) to help farmers compare crop rotations, with Bihar, India as our featured region. Looking for teammates skilled in data science/remote sensing, GIS mapping, agronomy knowledge, and UI/UX design. Passion for farming and climate resilience matters more than experience. Join us!
